title: Host settings
description: One installation's own defaults (<host-config>/settings.json, docs/host-config.md "Host settings"). Every key is optional; an absent key keeps the neutral default, which names no installation.

projectsRoot.description: The directory whose <name>-project entries are the projects. DEVPANEL_PROJECTS_DIR still wins; without either it is the directory holding the panel's own checkout.

proxyLogin.description: The reverse proxy's HTTP basic-auth login (server/proxy-user.mjs).

usersDir.description: Where the proxy publishes its users' credential files, <usersDir>/<user>/<file>; `{hostname}` is replaced by this host's name. DEVPANEL_USERS_DIR still wins. Without one, a login name is used as the actor but never verified.

digestFiles.description: Names of the files in a user's directory that hold a SHA-512 hex digest; any one admits. Default [".hash"].

headerMarkers.description: Words read as script header markers (`# <MARKER> key: value`) besides DEVPANEL, which is always read.

confinement.description: The unit user and home of `kind: candidate` commands when a project's testDrive.confinement does not name them.

forbiddenPrefixes.description: Entries of the projects root named <prefix>.<anything> are container filesystems no run may read (runtime/selection.mjs forbiddenRoots). Replaces the default ["production", "staging"].

linkBaseVariable.description: An environment variable the devpanel skill client reads as its link base when DEVPANEL_LINKBASE is unset (an editor terminal that exports one under its own name).

panelUrl.description: The panel's private address that tools/provision-reporter.mjs gives a deployment when --url is not passed.

seatGuidance.description: Installation notes given to run seats (runtime/host-guidance.mjs): CLAUDE.local.md and <host-config>/docs/, frozen into the run's evidence at start. Nothing is exposed without it.
